title: Book Two · Chapter 173: The Open Page
story:
On Monday morning, Ronan reaches the reading room before the first lesson. The door is closed. He stands beside it with the fourth practice page in his hand.

He does not fold the bottom edge under. His thumb rests near the HELP box.

He hears a door close along the passage. For a moment, he hopes it is hers. Then a younger student comes past and goes down the steps.

Ronan moves his bag away from the doorway.

He looks at the fourth page again. The right collection desk is clear on the plan. His own pencil mark is there, beside the stairs.

He remembers Leo pointing to the line. He can remember that easily. He can read the answer now. Leo found the important line during the task.

He turns the page over, then back. He wants the teacher to see the front and the bottom note together.

His fingers feel cold. He moves the page to his other hand and rubs the first hand against his trousers.

There are footsteps on the path. This time he looks up and keeps the paper open.

Miss Wu comes along the path with a pile of books. Ronan steps forward.

“May I speak to you about my record?”

“Yes. Come inside.”

He holds the door while she carries the books to her desk. Then he lays his paper in the clear space beside them.

“The fourth task says independent on the table,” he says. “Leo helped me. He found this line about the collection desk.”

He points to the line. Then he points to her note at the bottom.

Miss Wu looks from the note to the wall record. She takes the record down and puts it beside his page.

“You are right,” she says. “I put this in the wrong column.”

Ronan watches her finger move along his row.

“That leaves three,” she says.

“Yes.”

“When did you find the mistake?”

“Last Monday.”

She looks up. He does not look away.

“I wanted to keep the mark,” he says. “I did not write it, but I knew it was wrong.”

Miss Wu sets down her pencil. For a moment, the room is very quiet.

“You told me before the final check. Thank you,” she says. “The table is my mistake. I need to correct it.”

“Can I do another task?”

He knows everyone had six tasks. Still, he hopes Miss Wu can say yes.

“Not for this round,” she says. “Everyone had the same six practices. The rules give no extra task.”

Ronan presses one hand against the table edge.

“Then I cannot take the final tasks.”

“You will not be on the final shortlist.”

His throat hurts. He nods once. He knew he would lose this chance. Now Miss Wu has said it aloud. His eyes hurt too.

Miss Wu writes a correction on the record. She asks him to leave the original page while she checks all six results again. She will speak with him after lessons.

“All right,” he says.

At the door, he stops. “Please tell Leo the note says he helped. I do not want it to look like his mistake.”

“Leo did nothing wrong. I will explain the correction clearly.”

Ronan leaves with the folder under his arm. His throat still hurts. He stops beside the door and takes a slow breath.

The first bell rings. He walks to his classroom and takes his usual seat. When the teacher asks for the homework, he puts that book on the desk and opens it to the right page.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

column＝表格中的列；round＝这一轮；shortlist＝最终候选名单；throat＝喉咙。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan承认了错误记录之外的哪项自己的选择？
2. 为什么不能为他临时增加一次补测？

## 读句子

**The table is my mistake.**

拆开看：The table / is / my mistake.

这张表格的错误／是／我造成的。
